finalText:
Build's clean now — exit 0, "0 errors". The remaining 8 lines are genuine deprecation warnings (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, punycode, etc.), not build-breaking.

The real problem was two bugs in the link stage that the bundler bump exposed, both now fixed:
- `src/core/options.js:6` — read `options.retryCount` instead of the old `options.retries` (new bundler passes options in the `{ retryCount }` shape).
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` — treat `flags.backoffEnabled === undefined` as `false` instead of throwing (new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined`, not `false`).
